about: Advice for the RimWorld mood report, keyed by ThoughtDef or NeedDef name (* and ? are wildcards). Written by Claude for the owner on 10 November 2026 (agent-authored, for the owner's review), from how the game behaves, not from the game's own text. Every Def name was checked against a 1.7 install with its mods. Add to it freely; the report always labels these lines as advice. An entry is either the advice itself or {"text": ..., "fix": false} for a cause nothing can remove, which the report leaves out of its list of where to start.

thoughts.AteWithoutTable: Put tables and chairs where colonists eat; a meal at a table removes this.
thoughts.AteNutrientPasteMeal: Cook simple or fine meals instead: a stove, a cook, and the paste dispenser forbidden or taken down.
thoughts.AteRawFood: Keep cooked meals in stock and within reach, so nobody eats raw food.
thoughts.AteFungusAsIngredient_Despised: Their belief despises fungus: take fungus out of the cooks' ingredient filters.
thoughts.AteVeneratedAnimalMeat: Their belief venerates that animal: take its meat out of the cooks' ingredient filters and the food stockpiles.
thoughts.AteHumanlikeMeat*: Take human meat out of the cooks' ingredient filters for people who mind it.
thoughts.AteCorpse: Keep proper food within reach, so nobody eats a corpse.
thoughts.VFEFactory_AteProcessedMinceIngredient: Cook from whole ingredients instead of processed mince where you can.
thoughts.SleptInCold: Heat the bedrooms: a heater set to a comfortable temperature, with walls, doors and roof sealed.
thoughts.SleptInHeat: Cool the bedrooms: a cooler or air conditioner, and roofs that keep the sun out.
thoughts.SleptOutside: Give everyone a bed under a roof.
thoughts.SleptInBarracks: Give each colonist a bedroom of their own; shared barracks always cost mood unless a belief welcomes them.
thoughts.SleptInBedroom: Make bedrooms bigger, cleaner and better furnished: impressiveness turns this from a cost into a lift.
thoughts.SleepDisturbed: Keep noise and traffic out of bedrooms: no paths through them, and work and animals kept away.
thoughts.SoakingWet: Roof the walkways colonists use most, or move outdoor work out of the rain.
thoughts.EnvironmentDark: Light the places colonists work and walk.
thoughts.EnvironmentCold: Heat the rooms colonists spend time in, or dress them warmer.
thoughts.Pain: Treat injuries properly: good medicine, a hospital bed, and painkillers where the colony allows them.
thoughts.Naked: Give everyone clothes they can wear.
thoughts.ApparelDamaged: Replace or repair worn clothes; outfits can be set to swap clothes below a condition.
thoughts.DeadMansApparel: Set outfits to refuse clothes taken from the dead.
thoughts.HumanLeatherApparelSad: Keep human-leather clothes off people who mind them, with their outfits' filters.
thoughts.ObservedLayingCorpse: Bury, burn or haul away corpses quickly, and keep the dumping ground out of sight.
thoughts.ObservedLayingRottingCorpse: Bury, burn or haul away corpses quickly, and keep the dumping ground out of sight.
thoughts.Insulted: Keep quarrelling pawns apart: different work areas, rooms and meal times.
thoughts.InsultedMood: Keep quarrelling pawns apart: different work areas, rooms and meal times.

KnowColonistDied.text: Only time eases this; a funeral helps where their belief holds one.

PawnWithGoodOpinionDied.text: Only time eases this; a funeral helps where their belief holds one.

My*Died.text: Only time eases this; a funeral helps where their belief holds one.

thoughts.NeedFood: Keep meals in stock and within reach of where colonists work.
thoughts.NeedRest: Give colonists more sleep time in their schedules, and better beds.
thoughts.NeedJoy: More time for recreation in the schedules, and more kinds of it: a pawn bored of one kind needs another.
thoughts.NeedBeauty: Art, clean floors and no filth where colonists spend their time.
thoughts.NeedComfort: Comfortable seats where they eat and relax, and better beds.
thoughts.NeedOutdoors: Some time outside: work or recreation under the sky.
thoughts.NeedIndoors: Shelter for those who need it: indoor work and roofed rooms.
thoughts.NeedRoomSize: Bigger rooms where colonists live and work.
thoughts.HygieneLevel: Baths or showers within reach, and time in the schedule to use them.

Expectations.text: Not something to fix: what colonists expect rises with the colony's wealth.

drug_need: Keep the drug in stock for those addicted, or let them through withdrawal with care; an empty addiction brings withdrawal.
